_doc: Single source of truth for the rig. Directions are VIEW space, pointing FROM the surface TOWARDS the light (x right, y up, z towards viewer). rig.py builds Blender from this; paint.py and lightrig.json are derived from it.

env._strips_doc: [view-x lower edge, multiplier/2] along the reflected direction; bright softbox strip on the key side, dark flag on the right
env._bands_doc: [elevation lower edge (deg) of the reflected ray, radiance]; constant interpolation = hard strip edges
